_about: Player-facing one-line instructions for the logic events, used by the spoiler walkthrough (Generated/Generator/walkthrough.py). {spot} etc. are filled by the generator. status: suggested = written by Claude from the logic evidence, awaiting user review.

lamp_lit.text: Light the Oil Lamp: fill it with an Oil Can, then light it with a Matchbox or the Lighter.

jug_filled.text: Fill the Jug with water: search the spot F3:R10:HC7 with the Jug in hand.

knight_dead.text: Kill the Knight: throw the Very Heavy Statuette at him.

pirate_dead.text: Kill the Pirate with the Sword.

ghosts_dead.text: Banish the Dancers: play Saint-Saëns' Dance of Death on the Gramophone.

medusas_dead.text: Defeat both Medusas with the two Small Mirrors.

spiders_sprayed.text: Kill the Garden spiders: once they have dropped in (searching the Center Bed wakes them), use the Can of Bug Spray in the Garden.

boss_defeated.text: Final fight: defeat Pregzt (needs the Talisman and the lit Oil Lamp).
